hooks.command: LESSONS_FILE="${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-${USERPROFILE:-$HOME}/.claude}/lessons.md"; if [ -f "$LESSONS_FILE" ]; then echo '=== Lessons Learned (SessionStart hook) ==='; LESSONS_BYTES=$(wc -c < "$LESSONS_FILE" | tr -d ' '); if [ "$LESSONS_BYTES" -lt 9000 ]; then cat "$LESSONS_FILE"; else echo "$LESSONS_FILE is $LESSONS_BYTES bytes. Claude Code replaces hook output longer than 10,000 characters with a 2,000-character preview, so the file is not printed here. Read the whole file with the Read tool before the first task of this session; when Read returns a partial view, continue from the offset it names until the last line."; fi; echo '=== End of Lessons ==='; else echo 'No lessons.md found at ~/.claude/lessons.md'; fi

LESSONS_FILE="${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-${USERPROFILE:-$HOME}/.claude}/lessons.md"; if [ -f "$LESSONS_FILE" ]; then echo '=== Lessons Learned (reloaded after compaction) ==='; LESSONS_BYTES=$(wc -c < "$LESSONS_FILE" | tr -d ' '); if [ "$LESSONS_BYTES" -lt 9000 ]; then cat "$LESSONS_FILE"; else echo "$LESSONS_FILE is $LESSONS_BYTES bytes. Claude Code replaces hook output longer than 10,000 characters with a 2,000-character preview, so the file is not printed here. After compaction, re-read with the Read tool the entries relevant to the current task; when Read returns a partial view, continue from the offset it names."; fi; echo '=== End of Lessons ==='; else echo 'No lessons.md found at ~/.claude/lessons.md'; fi
